memories.content: The McCain campaign has received an invitation to the first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed participation. They are considering the terms and logistics.

The Commission on Presidential Debates has scheduled the first presidential debate for September 26, 2008, at the University of Mississippi. Both campaigns have been invited and are aware of the date and location. As of September 1, 2008, neither campaign has issued a public confirmation of their candidate's participation. The debate is expected to be a major media event.
